mode: TWO-SIGNATURE CUSTODY HANDOFF WITH LOCAL DISTINCT-ROOT PINS
checks: Actual ECDSA P-256 verification over separately canonicalized transfer and receiver receipt
SHA-256 receiver receipt binding to exact handoff bytes
Distinct declared sender and receiver identities, credentials, root ancestry, operator and administrator
Externally supplied root fingerprint pin consistency
Replay, chronology, permissions and revocation checks
limitations: A locally pinned credential root is not an independently authenticated real-world issuer
Declared distinct root IDs, administrators or keys are not proof of separate physical operators
No physical custody handoff verified; client attestation flags never grant ACT
